title: Microstructure evolution of a novel low-density Ti–Cr–Nb–V refractory high entropy alloy during cold rolling and subsequent annealing
process_description: prepared by vacuum arc melting of the elements in low-pressure, high-purity argon atmosphere inside a water-cooled copper cavity, followed by cold rolling to a thickness strain of 80% and subsequent annealing at 800, 1000, or 1200 °C for 1–100 h
